decisions.reason: The DPA management tool is close to the core offer and cheap to carry, and an early customer quote praising its agency focus suggests promise, so the option is worth keeping while uncertainty resolves.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page and is central to the firm's agency-focused strategy, so its value is still unfolding and dropping it would abandon a core option.
The configurable managed plan builds on the existing infrastructure at low marginal cost and has shown no negative signals, so keeping it preserves the option at little expense.
